provenance_note: The frozen contract predates outcome access. The first implementation incorrectly permuted predictor performance only among complete-case outcome rows. The repaired implementation follows the frozen eligible-colony null: S_i,t is permuted among all eligible colonies in the predictor island-season, while the future-missingness pattern remains fixed. Observed coefficients are unchanged; permutation p-values and null quantiles are superseded by the values below.

bridge_diagnostic.model: lag-2 relative redistribution ~ past performance S_t + current performance S_t+1 + outcome-interval prior size + colony fixed effect
bridge_diagnostic.interpretation: Past performance retains incremental information about t+1 to t+2 redistribution after measured t+1 performance, current group size and persistent colony identity are included.

ecological_interpretation: Relative reproductive performance has a weak one-year colony-specific memory, but the measured autocorrelation is no longer supported at two or three years under the frozen eligible-colony permutation null. In contrast, past performance retains a robust positive association with later within-island redistribution after measured t+1 performance, outcome-interval group size and persistent colony identity are included. The one-year performance memory is spatially heterogeneous and nearly disappears when Torgersen is excluded, whereas the bridge coefficient remains positive under every single-island exclusion. Thus a simple, spatially general persistent-state explanation is insufficient, but unmeasured persistent environment and measurement error remain viable; the carrier of the residual history cannot be identified from colony counts.
claim_boundary: Do not claim the persistent local environment has been ruled out.
Do not claim that the bridge coefficient proves a distinct biological-memory mechanism; imperfect measurement of S_t+1 or an unmeasured persistent state can leave incremental information in S_t.
Do not interpret the bridge model as causal mediation because S_t+1 is post-t.
Do not infer individual public-information use, prospecting, immigration, retention or breeding dispersal from colony counts alone.
The Torgersen leave-one-out pattern is a prespecified sensitivity showing spatial heterogeneity in performance autocorrelation, not proof that terrain or snow causes that autocorrelation.
The first complete-case-only permutation receipt is superseded by this repaired eligible-colony null.
